mesh_shifted_merged.notes: base mesh (~26k nodes); absorber centered at (0, 1mm, 0.56216mm)

mesh_refined_3x.notes: 3x refined (~63k nodes); recipe reconstructed after the fact, not re-verified against the existing directory

mesh_dual_base.notes: dual-TES base mesh (base resolution); single long absorber over two TES stacks at x=-tes_pitch/2 and x=+tes_pitch/2. Pinned to the original 5mm absorber / 4mm pitch experiment via parameter_overrides, independent of the project's global dabs_dx/tes_pitch defaults.

mesh_dual_20mm.notes: 20mm absorber, TES at x=±9.5mm (pitch 19mm), base resolution

mesh_dual_base_3x.notes: 3x-refined dual_tes (5mm absorber, 4mm pitch) -- test of L/R mesh-asymmetry convergence

mesh_dual_base_2x.notes: 2x-refined dual_tes (5mm absorber, 4mm pitch) -- test of L/R mesh-asymmetry convergence, direct-solver-tractable

mesh_dual_base_15x.notes: 1.5x-refined dual_tes (5mm absorber, 4mm pitch) -- interpolation point for L/R mesh-asymmetry convergence

mesh_dual_20mm_2x.notes: 2x-refined dual_tes (20mm absorber, TES at x=+/-9.5mm) -- L/R asymmetry reduction test

mesh_dual_base_localrefine.notes: local box refinement around TES_L/R+Stycast_L/R only (background mesh at 1x) -- cheap alternative to global 2x

mesh_dual_20mm_localrefine.notes: 20mm dual_tes with local TES-column refinement only (TES_LOCAL_REFINE_H env var required at build time) -- cheap alternative to global 2x

mesh_refined_3x_repart_x.notes: Validated 4-rank x partition; keeps nearly all non-conforming mortar pairs on the same rank.

mesh_hybrid_abs_tet_layers_prism_conform.notes: Pilot hybrid mesh: absorber uses tetrahedra; all support-stack volumes are triangular footprints extruded as prisms. The all-tetra mesh_refined_3x remains the regression reference.

mesh_hybrid_abs_tet_layers_prism_stack25.notes: Phase15 central stack/contact 25 um Box-field probe. The Box reaches the absorber-bottom contact plane, so tetrahedra immediately adjacent to that interface may refine; the absorber bulk remains nominally 50 um.

mesh_hybrid_abs_tet_layers_prism_stack17.notes: Phase16 central stack/contact 16.7 um Box-field steady probe. The default 0.4 mm half-width and 50 um transition are retained; only tetrahedra adjacent to the absorber-bottom contact may refine.
Phase17 stack17 Box-field plus an absorber-centre 16.7 um Ball field with a 150 um radius and 50 um transition.
Phase18 stack17 Box-field plus a 25 um / 75 um absorber-centre Ball field; MeshSizeExtendFromBoundary is disabled to prevent the Phase17 global refinement spread.
Phase19 final mesh-only sizing probe: stack17 Box plus 35 um / 50 um absorber-centre Ball field with MeshSizeExtendFromBoundary disabled.

mesh_hybrid_abs_tet_layers_prism_conform.notes: Four-rank x-slab partition of the conformal hybrid mesh.
4-rank hybrid partition without boundary ownership optimization.

mesh_pilot_auto_stycast32_tes1_sinx_laye.notes: Automatic one-axis convergence pilot: sinx_layers=1.0; fixed={'stycast_layers': 32.0, 'tes_layers': 1.0}.
Automatic one-axis convergence pilot: sinx_layers=2.0; fixed={'stycast_layers': 32.0, 'tes_layers': 1.0}.
Automatic one-axis convergence pilot: sinx_layers=4.0; fixed={'stycast_layers': 32.0, 'tes_layers': 1.0}.
